notes.title: Open Beta Update
notes.content: [p]Hi Fellows - Thanks so much for your patience and understanding as we try to resolve the server and queue issues we've experienced today. Trust us, we want you all to successfully get into the Beta -- we know you all have been waiting for it![/p][p]Wanted to share an update the investigation surrounding the issues is still ongoing, and we're looking into every possible way of getting this resolved as quickly as possible. We've been actively investigating the issues since Open Beta began, and needs a slight break to rest for a few hours (it's late in Sweden!) After some much needed rest, tomorrow, we will continue to troubleshoot and hope to resolve the issues.[/p][p]Thanks again for all of your support, and we hope everything will be resolved tomorrow so you all can jump into the Beta![/p]

notes.title: Fellowship Launches In Early Access On October 16!
notes.content: [h3][b]We’re excited to announce that Fellowship will be available on Steam in Early Access on October 16, 2025 for $24.99.  [/b][/h3][h3][b]Before Early Access launch, you’ll be able to play during our Open Beta via Steam from September 18 until September 23![/b] [/h3][p][/p][h3][b]ABOUT EARLY ACCESS[/b][/h3][p]The upcoming Early Access launch will mark just the beginning of Fellowship, as the game will be a constantly evolving adventure with a slew of content that will be added and evolve thanks to YOUR feedback throughout the course of Early Access. Our community comes first, and we take pride in working very closely with our most dedicated fans to create and shape the game over the various stages of development.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/4fdaec1d4676bb5be527325a38b2824d332a6de6.jpg"][/img]From the very beginning of Early Access, you will be able to experience the core vision of Fellowship: all dungeons, all the time – giving you the action you want right from the start. Following Early Access launch, there are plans for optional cosmetic purchases to be available. We'd like to make clear that these items will be purely cosmetic and not affect gameplay. More details on these items will be revealed sometime closer to Early Access launch.  Fellowship is planned to be in Early Access for approximately six months, but this can change depending on your feedback – as we will strive to discover what the community wants in Fellowship to help shape it into the best possible game it can be before it enters 1.0 launch next year. For the full 1.0 version of the game, we're planning on including more content, systems, and features. We have several plans in mind for content and features, but as mentioned before, we will also take your feedback to heart and may make adjustments if we hear that there’s something you really want to see in the game!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/3040363ade798883517171db7b550fc8604dc13d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]JOIN THE OPEN BETA![/b][/h3][p]Our upcoming Open Beta on Steam will kick off on [b]Thursday, September 18 at 10am Pacific Time and end on Tuesday, September 23 at 10am Pacific Time[/b]. For the Open Beta, there will be a North America, Europe and Asia server available. This playtest will you the chance to experience seven heroes (two Tanks, three DPS – including our recently-revealed DPS, Mara, and two Healers) who will be in Fellowship’s diverse roster of heroes, go on dungeon runs (both Ranked Dungeons and Quick Play Dungeons), take on challenging enemies and acquire epic loot along the way.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/9beccea2429425d0333f34ed82645e33c1153127.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Compared to the Steam Next Fest demo back in February, in addition to introducing a new DPS hero, Mara, the Open Beta will introduce new gameplay systems, including a fresh take on matchmaking and group finding, and an engaging progression system including Weapons, Gems, Talents, Crafting, Legendary items and more. Additionally, the Open Beta will introduce a new dungeon “Urrak Markets”, new gameplay features like cosmetic customization allowing you to change the look of different pieces of armor, new Gear, new Mounts, new visual element improvements and improvements on previous gameplay mechanics based on Steam Next Fest player feedback. The Open Beta will allow us to test multiplayer matchmaking improvements we’ve made and give us the chance to get one final round of player feedback before Fellowship’s Early Access launch.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/fa56cf93dc479e395255e186883fd1a7f97193bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you want to let us know your feedback as well, please [url="https://discord.gg/playfellowship"]join our wonderful community on Discord[/url]. In addition to discussing the game with fellow fans and finding players for dungeon runs, our dedicated feedback channel will be available for your input, and the dev team can’t wait to hear from you!  [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Patch Notes, August 19
notes.content:
[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] As Fellowship only works while you are running the Steam client on your computer, the game will now check if Steam is running and message you if it is not.
[*] The "F1, F2, F3, F4" keys on your keyboard should now correctly select allies in your party in the corresponding position in the party frame.
[/list]
[b]GROUP FINDER[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve heard and appreciate your feedback on the Group Finder feature. Today's patch includes a few fixes that hopefully will alleviate some of the issues you have been experiencing. There are some bigger fixes needed to address all the great feedback you have given which we unfortunately will not have time to get in for this Alpha Test.
[*] Declining applications no longer generates duplicates in the application window.
[*] When a player is declined a Group Application, there is no longer a pop-up confirm window. It is now messaged through the Chat instead (to avoid having to confirm each decline individually).
[*] There is a new "Auto-refresh" check box in the Group Finder when you create a group that you can toggle "off".
[*] There is also a new "Refresh" button for manually refreshing the Group Finder instead of automatically.
[*] Additional fixes have been made so the Group Finder now shows the correct heroes of each group.
[/list]
[b]THREAT[/b]
[list]
[*] Baseline threat generation for Tanks has been doubled.
[/list]
[b]HELENA[/b]
[list]
[*] Baseline efficiency of Toughness has been increased by 33%.
[*] Shield Slam target cap has been increased to 20 (was 5) and Shield Slam cleave range has been increased.
[/list]
[b]MEIKO[/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of damage each stone from the Stone Shield ability can mitigate before being destroyed has been increased by 33%.
[*] Lashing Stormkick target cap has been increased to 20 (was 5) and Lashing Stormkick cleave range has been increased.
[*] Gust is now off the Global Cooldown.
[*] Taunt is now off the Global Cooldown.
[*] Stone Stomp target cap has been increased to 20 (was 5).
[/list]
[b]RIME[/b]
[list]
[*] Winter Crash damage radius has been increased by 40%.
[*] Frigid Torrent damage has been increased by 30%.
[*] Frozen Shield is now off the Global Cooldown.
[/list]
[b]SYLVIE[/b]
[list]
[*] Yellow Flutterfly duration has been increased to 16 seconds (was 8 seconds).
[/list]
[b]VIGOUR[/b]
[list]
[*] Chastise mana cost reduced to 6 (was 18).
[*] Righteous Blast mana cost reduced to 18 (was 28).
[*] Word of Blessing healing increased by 40%.
[*] Blessed Orator talent now increases duration of active Word of Blessings by up to 10 seconds (was 6 seconds) upon casting Righteous Blast.
[*] Baseline spirit generation increased by 30%.
[*] Condemn Holy Orb generation increased by 40%.
[*] Avatar of Faith's duration has been increased to 9 seconds (was 6 seconds).
[*] Avatar of Faith's initial heal upon activation increased by 256%.
[*] The range of Vigour's abilities have been increased to be in line with Sylvie's ability range (almost doubled in some cases!).
[/list]
[b]ARDEOS[/b]
[list]
[*] Engulfing Flames' damage increased by 15%.
[*] Engulfing Flames' chance to generate Ember on tick increased to 20% (was 15%), and the amount of Ember generated has been increased by 42.5%.
[*] Searing Blaze damage reduced by 10%.
[*] Agonizing Blaze talent now increases damage dealt by 3% per stack (was 4%).
[*] Flicker Step is now off the Global Cooldown.
[*] Flame Shield is now off the Global Cooldown.
[/list]
[b]NIGHT PATROL[/b]
[list]
[*]Warlord Wogg's Lost Soul ability now ticks every 2.0 seconds (was 1.5 seconds) and has a total duration of 8 seconds (was 9 seconds).
[*] Warlord Wogg's Demonic Lash ability is now interruptable.
[*] Warlord Wogg now summons 2 Invokers to aid in the battle (was 2 Man-catchers).
[/list]
[b]ASCENSIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] The Ultimatum ascension now increases boss damage and health by 15% (was 20%).
[/list]
[b]CURSES[/b]
[list]
[*] Bloodshard damage reduced by 30%.
[*] Binding Ice damage reduced by 50%.
[*] Binding Ice now occurs 20% less frequently.
[/list]
[b]ARMOR SET BONUSES[/b]
[list]
[*] The Mirror Knight's/Sunspeaker's/Dunestalker's set - The 2-set bonus that increases/reduces Threat has been increased to 15% Threat (was 5%).
[*] The Deathchaser's/Sinner's set - The 2-set bonus that increases Max Mana has been increased to 15% Max Mana (was 10%).
[*] The Infernal/Blasphemer's/Bloodsworn set - The 5-set bonus that procs Cooldown Reduction has been reduced to 15% Cooldown Reduction (was 20%, tooltip incorrectly stated 30% before this patch).
[/list]
